signal: Blancco launched Asset Reimaging and a Cambrionix Apple Mac integration in early 2026, with Tom recently joining as CRO

email.body1:
Tom, congrats on the CRO seat at Blancco, and saw the Asset Reimaging and Cambrionix Mac launches land back to back.

New products plus a new commercial leader usually mean more in-market accounts than the team can cover before they cool, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Blancco off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Tom, quick follow-up for Blancco.

Stepping into the CRO role, you are likely resetting the pipeline target. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Blancco needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Tom, last bit of proof for Blancco.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Blancco's reply rate likely compares to other data-security vendors. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Tom, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters most in a CRO's first quarter, and I know setting the GTM foundation while products ship is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Blancco either way.
